newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Endesa to cut costs by 310 pta bln.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Endesa to cut costs by 310 pta bln.

text.p: Spanish electricity firm Endesa intends to reduce overall expenditure by 310 billion pesetas before 2001, chief executive Rafael Miranda said on Friday.

"We have a plan to cut costs by 310 billion pesetas, of which 80 billion pesetas will be operating and financial expenditure and 230 billion will correspond to recurrent investments," he told reporters at a lunch.
Miranda added that the firm's plans include a change in international strategy.
"We intend to change our investment strategy. We want to keep holdings or to make agreements that leave us with control of what we buy," he said.
Miranda added that Endesa will maintain a diversification policy, which will permit it to "remain leader among electric companies".
